name: RIHAI (रिहाई) | Official Music | Hindi Sad Rap Song | R LOFI 01
desc: RIHAI" is an emotional Hindi Sad Rap song about loneliness, hidden pain, life's responsibilities, broken dreams, and the desire to find peace and freedom.
lyrics:
🎵 Rihai (रिहाई)

(Intro)

Khamoshiyon ke saaye mein, khud ko dhoondhta hoon main,
Bheed bhari is duniya mein, tanha ghoomta hoon main...

(Verse 1 - Rap)

Chehre pe hansi ka ek naqaab lagaye phirta hoon,
Andar hi andar har roz thoda-thoda girta hoon.
Duniya kehti hai ki waqt sab kuch bhar deta hai,
Par ye waqt hi toh hai jo zakhm aur gehre kar deta hai.

Kandhon pe zimmedariyon ka bojh badhta jaata hai,
Khwabon ka parinda ab udne se ghabrata hai.
Sab poochhte hain haal mera, par sunna koi nahi chahta,
Is banawati shehar mein ab mera dil nahi lagta.

(Chorus)

Rihai... mujhe riha kar do is dard se,
Rihai... mujhe azaad kar do is qarz se.
Thak chuka hoon main ab, jhoothi muskaan sajate-sajate,
Khud se hi door ho gaya, apnon ko manate-manate.

(Verse 2 - Rap)

Andheri raaton mein ab neend bhi rooth jaati hai,
Umeed ki har ek dor chupchaap toot jaati hai.
Bachpan ki woh galiyan, woh befikri ke pal,
Aaj ki is bhaag-daud mein ho gaye hain ojhal.

Main ladna chahta hoon par raahein nazar nahi aati,
In band deewaron se meri saansein baahar nahi ja paati.
Bas ek pal ka sukoon, bas thodi si panaah chahiye,
Mujhe is uljhi zindagi se nikalne ki raah chahiye.

(Bridge)

Koi toh sune mere dil ki ye ankahi sada,
Kab tak rahoonga main khud se hi aise juda...

(Chorus)

Rihai... mujhe riha kar do is dard se,
Rihai... mujhe azaad kar do is qarz se.
Bas ek baar khul kar saans lena chahta hoon main,
Is qaid se nikal kar jeena chahta hoon main...

(Outro)

Jeena chahta hoon main...
Bas riha hona chahta hoon main...
